Introduction

Sunwoo is a South Korean trainee under Evermore Entertainment. She is a member of the pre-debut girl group EVERMORE MUSE.

She is best known for being a contestant in the competitive reality television shows Top 10 Student, Girls Planet 999, Stars Awakening, and Universe Ticket.
